before.requirement: Explicitly select a 16-byte hash salt with a nonzero first key word before parsing.
before.reason: Before the change, the parser stored an unsigned-long salt and copied it into a SipHash key whose first word was fixed to zero. The reconstructed source also confirms no XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes definition in xmlparse.c.

source_evidence.quote: Verified preimage file expat/lib/xmlparse.c has no function definition named XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes. The entire after definition consists of added lines. This establishes absence in this file only; other implementations or equivalent paths must still be considered.

after.requirement: Explicitly select a 16-byte hash salt with a nonzero first key word before parsing.
after.reason: The new public setter accepts 16 entropy bytes before parsing, and hashing copies the full stored key. The fixed harness still calls only the legacy setter, which zeros the first key word.

source_evidence.quote:
/* Added in Expat 2.7.6. */
XML_Bool XMLCALL
XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes(XML_Parser parser,
                       const uint8_t entropy[16]);
Sets the hash salt to use for internal hash calculations. Helps in preventing DoS attacks based on predicting hash function behavior. In order to have an effect this must be called before parsing has started. Returns XML_TRUE if successful, XML_FALSE when called after XML_Parse or XML_ParseBuffer or when parser is NULL.

claims.reason: The same explicit 16-byte selection capability was unavailable in the before contract and is supported after the change. The old harness has no route to it.
